description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 score, which is a measure of the accuracy of a classification model. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, ranging from 0.6 to 1.5, and the y-axis represents the Macro-F1 score, ranging from 48% to 58%. The plot includes two lines, one in pink and one in purple, each representing different conditions. The pink line shows a fluctuating trend, with the highest score of 58% at 1.0 tokens and the lowest score of 48% at 1.5 tokens. The purple line, labeled "w/o material information," shows a more consistent trend, with scores ranging between 52% and 54%. The plot does not provide any additional context or information about the conditions represented by the two lines.
